title: Riemann Hypothesis via Spectral Descent — Kim–Sarnak Route
description: Lean 4 formalization of the Kim–Sarnak spectral-descent route from the Laplacian gap λ₁ ≥ 975/4096 through Selberg and Bost–Connes ingredients toward the Riemann Hypothesis. This repository is part of David Fox's Opera Numerorum ensemble.
